title: Mini surge contribution heat tally - quick tracker
content:
Purpose: quick, one-sheet view of who’s doing what for the July surge window (week of 2029-07-15). Not an exhaustive plan — lightweight tally + blockers for immediate handoffs. Keep this doc small and mutable; copy into the weekly handback if we need longer retention.

Top-line summary:
- Snapshot date: 2029-07-15 09:30 PT (last touch: Sofia)
- Total named contributors: 14
- Total estimated hours (next 7 days): 212h (est)
- Immediate blockers flagged: 3 (network quota, infra deploy window, legal review for export controls)
- Quick asks: 1) confirm SRE runway for pt-queue autoscale on 7/17, 2) product signoff on reduced cache TTL for burst test by 7/16, 3) legal to triage export-control checklist by 7/18

Compact table (columns: name | team | role for surge | est hours (7d) | primary blocker | slack channel / owner | notes)
Sofia Lin | product-ops | surge coordinator / contact | 18h | n/a | #prod-ops | owning this sheet; will run nightly rollup
Marcus Reed | engineering-platform | infra lead (burst capacity) | 40h | cloud quota request pending | #infra-burst | chasing quota with cloud sales; fallback: move some traffic to region-eu
Anjali Rao | applied-ml | model quant pilot / tune | 30h | cannot repro perf variance on staging | #applied-ml | will capture perf logs and hand to runtime team 7/16
Diego Morales | sre | runbook / oncall rota | 28h | overlapping holidays (coverage gap) | #sre-ops | requesting 2 temp swaps from SRE pool
Priya Nair | solutions-eng | customer outreach / docs | 16h | customer A wants SLA clarification | #se-customer-A | prepping one-pager for onboarding call 7/18
Eve Park | private-deployments | env setup / firewall | 12h | firewall rule needs legal OK | #private-deploy | blocked on legal export-control item
Rakesh Patel | serving-runtime | runtime tuning / kernel tests | 18h | longer quant test queue | #runtime | will run 2 short experiments 7/16-7/17
Grace Miller | dedicated | capacity planning / quotas | 10h | none | #dedicated | will confirm burst pricing alignment
Hannah Kim | console-and-tooling | rollout dashboard | 10h | dashboard auth edge-case | #console | small patch to fix scope 7/16
Liam O'Connor | observability | tracing + sample dashboards | 8h | high-cardinality log costs | #observability | temporary sampling rule to be applied 7/16
Olga Ivanov | security-and-compliance | compliance gate review | 10h | priority: export-control details | #security | would like legal to prioritize 7/18
Tariq Aziz | platform-engineering | routing policy config | 8h | confusion on fallback rules | #platform | propose one-page mapping 7/15
Mei Chen | developer-experience | SDK release for surge flags | 6h | release window overlap | #devexp | release will be small patch 7/16 evening
Carlos Vega | professional-services | onboarding pilots | 8h | customer pilot scheduling | #ps-onboard | pushing two pilot demos to 7/19

Counts / quick math (very rough):
- Eng + infra (Marcus + Rakesh + Rakesh-adj): 76h (~36%)
- SRE + Observability: 36h (~17%)
- Product / Ops / SE: 44h (~21%)
- Security/Legal/Private deployment: 22h (~10%)
- DX / PS / Others: 34h (~16%)
- Note: totals include rounding; used fast estimates from owners.

Immediate risk items (top 3):
1) Cloud quota limit for bursting in us-west-2 — Marcus is on the ticket with CS. If quota not approved by 7/17 AM we fallback to region-eu which will add 60ms median latency for ~40% of traffic (customer impact estimate).
2) Legal export-control checklist blocking firewall/profile for private deploy pilot (Eve/Olga). Impact: pilot cannot go live for Customer B until signoff; timeline slips by ~3 business days if not addressed 7/18.
3) Overlapping holidays reduces SRE reserve coverage on 7/18-7/19 — Diego requests two temp swaps from other SRE pods. If no swap, operational risk for weekend scheduling increases.

Open questions / decisions needed (short):
- Do we accept the EU fallback? Product to confirm tradeoff (latency vs availability) by 7/16 17:00 PT. (Owner: Sofia / Priya)
- Can Legal triage export-control as high priority? If yes, legal to reply with ETA by 7/15 EOD. (Owner: Olga / Legal)
- Are we ok with temporary TTL reduction on shared cache during burst window (expected to increase origin load by ~8%)? Product decision by 7/16. (Owner: Product Leads)

Quick suggestions for handoff / next update cadence:
- Nightly rollup (Sofia) — short email + updated line items in this sheet at 21:00 PT each day 7/15–7/21.
- SRE/Infra sync 7/16 10:00 PT — quick stand to confirm quota fallback plan.
- Legal micro-review 7/15 16:00 PT — 30m to decide export-control precedence.

Notes to self (scratch):
- If Marcus gets quota by 7/17 morning, call off EU fallback and flag the region switch off in telemetry so we can revert without config drift.
- Add small column 'post-mortem owner' after surge to this sheet (follow-up item).
- Slurp relevant logs into /tmp/surge-logs-2029-07-15 for the ML team to sample.

History / provenance:
- This started as a 2-page slack thread in #prod-ops -> converted to this quick sheet to centralize owners.
- Cross-linked to PRODOPS-4123 (surge runbook actionables) and ENGINF-278 (burst capacity quoter).

If you're an owner listed above: update your est hours and blocker as soon as you know; if you can't edit this sheet, ping Sofia or add a comment.
